## Common WHERE Filters

-- 标准分区过滤（读写均使用）

  AND grass_date = date'${BIZ_YESTERDAY}'

-- 按类目过滤（类目分位数计算）
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date = date'${BIZ_YESTERDAY}'
  AND l3_cat > 0   -- 根据需要切换 l1_cat / l2_cat / l3_cat

  AND grass_date = date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
  AND impression_7d >= 100
  AND click_7d > 0
  AND avg_order_7d > coalesce(avg_order_cnt_14d, 0)

## Common JOIN Patterns

```sql
-- 1. JOIN 类目分位数 temp view（好货评分）
FROM mp_paidads.ads_sc_potential_product_ads_item_temp__reg a
LEFT JOIN category_data ON a.final_cat = category_data.cat_id

-- 2. FULL JOIN 低价潜力商品（构建最终推荐表）
FROM (good_potential items from temp table) a
FULL JOIN (
    SELECT d.item_id, shop_id, 1 as low_price_potential
    FROM srdi_mart.dwd_sr_data_warehouse_pb_one_variation_model_minf d
    LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.ads_simple_roi2_npb_item_hi__reg_s0_live c
      ON d.item_id = c.item_id
    WHERE c.item_id IS NULL  -- 排除 NPB 在投商品
) b ON a.item_id = b.item_id
```

## Common Aggregations

```sql
-- 类目级分位数（category_data temp view 构建）
SELECT
    l3_cat AS cat_id
    ,APPROX_PERCENTILE(CASE WHEN impression_7d >= 100 AND click_7d > 0 THEN ctrcr_7d END, 0.5) AS ctrcr_p50
    ,APPROX_PERCENTILE(gmv_usd_7d, 0.9)  AS gmv_p90
    ,APPROX_PERCENTILE(gmv_usd_7d, 0.6)  AS gmv_p60
    ,APPROX_PERCENTILE(CASE WHEN order_growth_rate > 0 THEN order_growth_rate END, 0.6) AS order_growth_p60
    ,APPROX_PERCENTILE(order_cnt_7d, 0.8) AS order_p80
FROM mp_paidads.ads_sc_potential_product_ads_item_temp__reg
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date = date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
  AND l3_cat > 0
GROUP BY l3_cat
-- 同样结构对 l2_cat、l1_cat 各跑一次，UNION ALL 合并
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: 写入 temp 表 — 主查询（从 OMNI + item 维表构建）

```sql
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ads_sc_potential_product_ads_item_temp__reg
PARTITION (grass_region, grass_date)
SELECT
    a.item_id
    ,b.shop_id
    ,l1_cat, l2_cat, l3_cat
    ,CASE
        WHEN l3_cat > 0 THEN l3_cat
        WHEN l2_cat > 0 THEN l2_cat
        ELSE l1_cat
    END AS final_cat
    ,ROUND(ctrcr, 5) AS ctrcr_7d
    ,ROUND(gmv_usd_7d, 5) AS gmv_usd_7d
    ,ROUND(avg_order_7d, 5) AS avg_order_7d
    ,ROUND(order_cnt_7d, 5) AS order_cnt_7d
    ,ROUND(avg_order_cnt_14d, 5) AS avg_order_cnt_14d
    ,ROUND(CASE WHEN avg_order_cnt_14d > 0
                AND avg_order_7d > avg_order_cnt_14d
           THEN avg_order_7d / avg_order_cnt_14d - 1 END, 5) AS order_growth_rate
    ,impression_7d
    ,click_7d
    ,upper('${region}') AS grass_region
    ,date'${BIZ_YESTERDAY}' AS grass_date
FROM (
    SELECT item_id
        ,SUM(click_cnt) AS click_7d
        ,SUM(impression_cnt) AS impression_7d
        ,SUM(gmv_usd) AS gmv_usd_7d
        ,SUM(IF(date_type = 1, order_cnt, 0)) AS order_cnt_7d
        ,SUM(IF(date_type = 1, order_cnt, 0))
         / (7 - (SELECT campaign_days_7d FROM campaign_days)) AS avg_order_7d
        ,SUM(IF(date_type = 1, order_cnt, 0))
         / SUM(impression_cnt) AS ctrcr
        ,SUM(IF(date_type = 2, order_cnt, 0))
         / (7 - (SELECT campaign_days_14d FROM campaign_days)) AS avg_order_cnt_14d
    FROM (
        -- 近7天数据（排除大促日）
        SELECT item_id
            ,SUM(item_click_cnt_1d) AS click_cnt
            ,SUM(item_impr_cnt_1d) AS impression_cnt
            ,SUM(gmv_usd_1d) AS gmv_usd
            ,SUM(order_1d) AS order_cnt, 1 AS date_type
        FROM traffic_omni_oa.dws_user_item_feature_sales_funnel_metrics_1d__reg_sensitive_live
        WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
          AND local_date IN (SELECT EXPLODE(grass_date_7D) FROM campaign_days)
          AND local_date NOT IN (/* exclude campaign days */)
          AND item_id > 0
          AND (order_1d > 0 OR item_click_cnt_1d > 0 OR item_impr_cnt_1d > 0)
        GROUP BY 1
        UNION ALL
        -- 对比期(14天前)订单数据
        SELECT item_id
            ,NULL AS click_cnt, NULL AS impression_cnt, NULL AS gmv_usd
            ,COALESCE(SUM(order_1d), 0) AS order_cnt, 2 AS date_type
        FROM traffic_omni_oa.dws_user_item_feature_sales_funnel_metrics_1d__reg_sensitive_live
        WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
          AND local_date IN (SELECT EXPLODE(grass_date_14D) FROM campaign_days)
          AND local_date NOT IN (/* exclude campaign days */)
          AND item_id > 0 AND order_1d > 0
        GROUP BY 1
    )
    GROUP BY 1
    HAVING SUM(IF(date_type = 1, order_cnt, 0)) > 0
) a
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        itemid AS item_id, shopid AS shop_id
        ,COALESCE(cat1, 0) AS l1_cat
        ,COALESCE(cat2, 0) AS l2_cat
        ,COALESCE(cat3, 0) AS l3_cat
    FROM mkplpaidads_data.rcmd_score_stats
    WHERE dt = '${BIZ_TODAY}'
      AND country = upper('${region}')
      AND cat1 > 0 AND sku_status
) b ON a.item_id = b.item_id
LEFT JOIN (/* exclude NPB items */) c ON a.item_id = c.item_id
LEFT JOIN (/* exclude brushing items */) d ON a.item_id = d.item_id
WHERE c.item_id IS NULL AND d.item_id IS NULL
```

### Snippet 2: 下游读取 — 好货评分 + 低价潜力合并

```sql
SELECT
    CONCAT('item_', grass_region, '_', item_id, ':potential_product') AS key
    ,marshal_item(item_id, CAST(good_potential_score AS bigint),
                  CAST(low_price_score AS bigint)) AS value
    ,COALESCE(a.item_id, b.item_id) AS item_id
    ,COALESCE(a.shop_id, b.shop_id) AS shop_id
    ,COALESCE(good_potential, 0) AS good_potential_score
    ,COALESCE(low_price_potential, 0) AS low_price_score
    ,l1_cat, l2_cat, l3_cat
    ,ctrcr_7d, gmv_usd_7d, order_cnt_7d, order_growth_rate
    ,impression_7d
    ,ctrcr_p50, gmv_p90, gmv_p60, order_growth_p60, order_p80
    ,upper('${region}') AS grass_region
    ,date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}') AS grass_date
FROM (
    SELECT item_id, shop_id, l1_cat, l2_cat, l3_cat, final_cat
        ,ctrcr_7d, gmv_usd_7d, order_cnt_7d, order_growth_rate
        ,impression_7d
        ,ctrcr_p50, gmv_p90, gmv_p60, order_growth_p60, order_p80
        ,1 AS good_potential
    FROM mp_paidads.ads_sc_potential_product_ads_item_temp__reg a
    LEFT JOIN category_data ON a.final_cat = category_data.cat_id
    WHERE a.grass_region = upper('${region}')
      AND a.grass_date = date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
      AND impression_7d >= 100
      AND click_7d > 0
      AND avg_order_7d > coalesce(avg_order_cnt_14d, 0)
      AND (/* multi-condition scoring using category percentiles */) = true
) a
FULL JOIN (
    SELECT d.item_id, shop_id, 1 AS low_price_potential
    FROM srdi_mart.dwd_sr_data_warehouse_pb_one_variation_model_minf d
    LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.ads_simple_roi2_npb_item_hi__reg_s0_live c
      ON d.item_id = c.item_id
    WHERE c.item_id IS NULL
) b ON a.item_id = b.item_id
```
